title: Chief Architect / Director of Engineering – PHP & Laravel
description:
**Job Title:** Enterprise Tech Lead / Chief Software Architect (PHP / Laravel Ecosystem)

**Department:** Engineering & Technology

**Experience Level:** 15 – 20 Years

**Location:** [City, Country / Hybrid / Remote]

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Purpose

We are seeking a visionary **Chief Architect / Senior Director of Engineering** with 15–20 years of hands-on and strategic software engineering experience to lead the modernization, architecture, and overall technical strategy of our web applications and platform ecosystem.

In this executive engineering role, you will define high-level architecture, modernize legacy PHP stacks to the latest Laravel versions (Laravel 12/13), oversee high-concurrency microservices, integrate AI/ML workflows, drive cloud-native standards (AWS/GCP), and mentor engineering directors, tech leads, and development teams.

Key Responsibilities1. Technical Strategy & Enterprise Architecture

* **System Design & Modernization:** Architect, evaluate, and evolve high-scale, fault-tolerant enterprise applications handling millions of daily requests using **PHP 8.x**, modern **Laravel**, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
* **Legacy Refactoring & Migrations:** Lead multi-year migration strategies moving legacy PHP monoliths (Core PHP, CodeIgniter, Symfony, older Laravel versions) into scalable, API-first microservices or clean, modular monoliths.
* **Technology Roadmap:** Partner with executive leadership (CTO, VP of Product) to translate business goals into a robust, future-proof engineering and technology roadmap.
* **Ecosystem Integration:** Design vector/semantic search mechanisms, API gateways, queues, and AI/LLM integrations using modern Laravel ecosystem tools (Laravel AI SDK, Reverb, Horizon, Octane, Vapor).IT Path Solutions

2. Engineering Standards & Governance

* **Technical Governance:** Establish organization-wide standards for code quality, automated testing (Pest / PHPUnit), security policies (OWASP, CSRF, identity/OAuth2), and CI/CD pipelines.Swaraa Tech Solutions
* **Performance & Scalability:** Optimize database queries, caching strategies (Redis, Memcached), asynchronous queues, and database engines (PostgreSQL, MySQL/Aurora, MongoDB) for extreme load handling.IT Path Solutions
* **DevOps & Infrastructure Oversight:** Work with Infrastructure/SRE teams to design cloud architecture, containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes), and zero-downtime deployment pipelines.

3. Leadership, Mentorship & Vendor Management

* **Team Development:** Direct and mentor Technical Leads, Engineering Managers, and Senior Developers, driving a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
* **Hiring & Scaling:** Partner with Talent Acquisition to attract top-tier engineering talent and build high-performing engineering organizations.
* **Vendor & Tooling Decisions:** Evaluate third-party SaaS, APM tools (Datadog, New Relic), cloud services, and external agencies/consultants to maximize ROI and developer efficiency.

Qualifications & Requirements

* **Total Experience:** 15+ years of software development experience, with at least **8–10 years spent in core PHP and Laravel ecosystems** at a lead or architectural scale.
* **Architecture Track Record:** Proven experience designing and operating large-scale SaaS platforms, e-commerce engines, or enterprise web platforms handling high concurrency and volume.
* **Deep PHP & Laravel Expertise:**
* Mastery of PHP 8.x features (Attributes, Fiber, JIT, type systems).IT Path Solutions
* Deep internals knowledge of Laravel (Service Container, Middleware pipelines, Eloquent ORM tuning, Laravel Reverb, Horizon, Octane, Swoole/RoadRunner).Laravel
* **Database & Data Architectural Mastery:**
* Advanced SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning, and read-replica strategies in MySQL / PostgreSQL.
* Experience with NoSQL (MongoDB, ElasticSearch, Redis) and vector databases for semantic search.
* **Cloud & DevOps:** Deep expertise in AWS / GCP / Azure services, Docker, Kubernetes, Serverless architecture, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Soft Skills & Leadership Profile

* **Strategic Thinking:** Ability to balance immediate engineering delivery with long-term technological longevity.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Exceptional communication skills to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical business leaders and executives.
* **Problem Solving:** Proven experience resolving complex system outages, performance bottlenecks, and security vulnerabilities.

Pay: ₹26,000.00 - ₹120,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Java Full Stack + Agentic AI Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

Lead Software Engineer role in a global asset and wealth management technology team responsible for designing and delivering complex hybrid cloud applications using modern Java React and microservices. The role drives high quality engineering practices secure and scalable solutions and close collaboration with product operations and business stakeholders to enhance client facing platforms and advisor tools.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end to end design and delivery of complex hybrid cloud applications that support asset and wealth management products ensuring scalable secure and resilient solutions for clients and advisors.
* Drive architecture decisions for microservices based platforms using Java seventeen Spring Boot and AWS services aligning technical direction with long term business and technology strategies.
* Oversee development of responsive user interfaces using React Js and JavaScript that offer intuitive portfolio views transaction workflows and advisory tools for wealth management customers.
* Provide technical guidance on core Java patterns concurrency collections and performance tuning to ensure robust backend services powering account management trading and reporting functions.
* Coordinate integration of microservices with SQL and PL SQL MySQL data stores enabling consistent data access complex queries and reliable transaction processing across asset and wealth management systems.
* Guide implementation of secure APIs for internal and external consumers enforcing authentication authorization and data protection standards aligned with regulatory expectations in the financial domain.
* Collaborate with product managers business analysts and operations partners to translate asset and wealth management requirements into detailed technical designs and incremental delivery plans.
* Ensure high engineering standards through rigorous code reviews unit and integration testing approaches and continuous improvement of development practices across the team.
* Manage deployment pipelines on AWS using automated build and release processes supporting blue green or rolling deployments and minimizing client impact during production changes.
* Direct root cause analysis and resolution of complex production incidents in day shift hybrid environment improving system stability and reducing service disruption for portfolio and advisory services.
* Promote observability by defining logging metrics and alerts for microservices and front end modules enabling proactive monitoring of performance capacity and user experience.
* Coordinate cross team collaboration with data security and infrastructure groups to optimize application performance database access patterns and cloud resource usage for wealth platforms.
* Drive documentation of application architectures data flows service contracts and operational runbooks to ensure clarity maintainability and smooth onboarding of new engineering talent.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate extensive experience of seventeen to twenty one years in enterprise software engineering with deep hands on expertise in Java core Java and Spring Boot for mission critical systems.
* Show strong proficiency in modern Java seventeen features including streams functional constructs and improved memory management techniques applied to high volume financial applications.
* Exhibit advanced skills in React Js and JavaScript for building modular reusable components and state driven interfaces that improve client engagement with wealth management platforms.
* Bring solid background in designing and maintaining microservices architectures including service decomposition inter service communication and fault tolerance in distributed environments.
* Apply expertise in AWS cloud services such as compute storage and managed databases to design secure and cost efficient deployment topologies for asset and wealth management workloads.
* Possess strong SQL and PL SQL MySQL skills for schema design query optimization and stored procedure development supporting portfolio accounting risk analytics and regulatory reporting needs.
* Demonstrate proven experience in asset and wealth management domain including portfolio construction order management client reporting and compliance concepts embedded into application workflows.
* Show familiarity with hybrid working models and distributed agile practices ensuring effective collaboration across onsite and remote locations without requiring frequent travel.
* Exhibit strong mentoring and leadership capabilities by coaching engineers setting coding standards and fostering a culture of ownership quality and continuous learning.
* Display solid understanding of secure software development practices relevant to financial services including encryption data privacy controls and auditability of critical operations.

title: Staff Engineer, Full-Stack Development
description:
**Date posted** 10/11/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19197****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/11/2026**

### **Full-Stack Web Developer**

### **We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You are an early-career developer who has moved past tutorials and built things that actually run in production or close to it. You know the difference between code that works on your laptop and code that someone else can deploy, maintain, and extend six months later. When something breaks, you dig in. When requirements are unclear, you ask the right questions instead of guessing or waiting.

You have written enough JavaScript and TypeScript to know when a component is getting too complicated, and you care about that. Working across front-end, back-end, and database layers does not intimidate you because you have done it before, even if not at scale. You learn by building, not by collecting certifications.

Small teams appeal to you because your work is visible and your contributions matter from day one. You want to be in a place where asking good questions is valued, where senior engineers actually review your code and explain the why, and where you can see the impact of what you ship. At Synopsys, you will work on internal platforms that employees across the company depend on, and the team you join operates like a high-trust startup inside a global organization.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Build and maintain full-stack web applications using the PANN stack: PostgreSQL, Angular, NestJS, and Node.js
* Implement features across the entire application layer, from UI components in Angular to API endpoints in NestJS to database schema changes in PostgreSQL
* Work with Prisma ORM to model data, manage migrations, and write clean database access logic
* Collaborate with cybersecurity, engineering, and business teams to translate requirements into working software that solves real problems
* Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and orchestrate services in environments managed with Kubernetes, Nginx, and Apache
* Contribute to AI-enabled features including retrieval-augmented generation workflows, prompt engineering, and automation that pulls from internal knowledge repositories
* Support CI/CD pipelines and help maintain production systems through monitoring, debugging, and performance tuning

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Your code will power internal platforms used daily by employees across Synopsys to get work done faster and more securely
* You will reduce manual effort and operational overhead by automating repetitive workflows and integrating disconnected systems
* The features you build will improve how teams access organizational knowledge, make decisions, and collaborate across functions
* Your contributions will help scale cybersecurity, compliance, and engineering operations across a 30,000-person global organization
* You will enable better data-driven decision-making by building intuitive interfaces that surface the right information at the right time
* Working in a small, high-impact team means your individual work will be visible and valued, not lost in a backlog
* You will help lay the foundation for scalable solutions that can be adopted across multiple business units as the platform grows

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent hands-on experience building and shipping web applications
* 5+ years of experience developing full-stack web applications, though stronger evidence of end-to-end delivery can matter more than years
* Hands-on experience with the PANN technology stack: PostgreSQL, Angular, NestJS, and Node.js in real projects, not just side experiments
* Solid working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and REST API design
* Experience using Prisma or a comparable ORM for data modeling, schema migrations, and database access patterns
* Familiarity with Docker for containerization and exposure to Kubernetes, Nginx, or Apache in deployment contexts
* Practical exposure to AI technologies such as large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or automation workflows, whether through work, coursework, or personal projects
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, testing methodologies, and secure coding principles
* Experience integrating systems through APIs and working with both relational and non-relational databases
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, you can explain what you built, why you built it that way, and what tradeoffs you made

### **Who You Are**

* You take ownership of your work and follow through, even when it means asking for help or clarification along the way
* When you encounter a problem you do not immediately know how to solve, you research, test, and ask targeted questions instead of spinning or guessing
* You write code with the next person in mind, whether that is a teammate doing a review or your future self debugging at 3pm on a Tuesday
* You are comfortable working in a small team where accountability is high and your contributions are visible from day one
Curiosity drives you, especially around emerging technologies like AI, and you are eager to* them to solve real business problems, not just experiment
* You can collaborate effectively with people outside engineering, translating technical constraints into language that product and business stakeholders actually understand
* You care about user experience and think through how the features you build will actually be used, not just whether they technically function
* Results matter to you more than process for its own sake, you want to ship things that work and make a measurable difference

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

Your team develops platforms and capabilities that help scale cybersecurity, compliance, engineering, and business operations across Synopsys. The team operates with a startup mindset, focusing on high-impact initiatives, rapid execution, and practical innovation. You will work closely with a small group of technical and domain experts to build solutions that enable automation, knowledge management, and data-driven decision making. Individual contributions are highly visible, and you will have direct access to senior engineers who will review your work, explain tradeoffs, and help you grow.

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

* You care about user experience and think through how the features you build will actually be used, not just whether they technically function
* Results matter to you more than process for its own sake, you want to ship things that work and make a measurable difference

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

Your team develops platforms and capabilities that help scale cybersecurity, compliance, engineering, and business operations across Synopsys. The team operates with a startup mindset, focusing on high-impact initiatives, rapid execution, and practical innovation. You will work closely with a small group of technical and domain experts to build solutions that enable automation, knowledge management, and data-driven decision making. Individual contributions are highly visible, and you will have direct access to senior engineers who will review your work, explain tradeoffs, and help you grow.

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Director of Engineering - Studio Team
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.


Living our values everyday results in our team\-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.


The Five9 Studio engineering team drive the realization of practical AI solutions for the contact centre environment. Our existing Studio product stack is built on Laravel Framework\-PHP, Python and Vue.js technology deployed in private and public clouds. We leverage the latest cloud AI services such as OpenAI, Google Speech and Dialogflow, Deepgram, IBM Watson and Wellsaid and integrate into Five9 wider well\-developed microservices platform.



Our vision for practical AI involves equipping contact centre agents, supervisors and managers with user interfaces that guide and summarize their work, identify points of coaching and support, and fully automate routine interactions. This latter part is the focus of the Studio Engineering team, enabling our customers to create and tune implementation of AI agents into their voice and digital channels for their end\-customer self\-service and steering to best agent.


**Role purpose**



The purpose of this role is to build and lead a team of developers and quality assurance that will design, develop, and maintain software solutions and drive the implementation of best practices in continuous integration, continuous delivery and service ownership within a fast\-paced environment.



This role requires a hands\-on approach and while it spends some time undertaking development, it will ultimately contribute to delivering exceptional customer experience.


**How you contribute**


* Lead and mentor a team of software development engineers responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring and tooling our cloud services.
* Identify and hire suitable employees in partnership with the Talent Acquisition team.
* Provide coaching, feedback, and development opportunities to enhance skills, motivation, and performance of team members.
* Oversee the design, development, and implementation of features and functionality aligning with the feature goals. Ensure adherence to best practices, standards, and security protocols.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and quality assurance professionals, to ensure that everyone is aligned around goals and progress.
* Drive the adoption of modern technologies, tools and practices to streamline development workflows, improve efficiency, and enhance the quality and reliability of our software.
* Apply strong understanding of various programming languages, frameworks, and development methodologies, to enable informed decisions and solve complex technical challenges.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues by applying problem\-solving skills to identify the root causes and implement effective solutions.
* Manage relationships with cloud service providers, tool vendors, and other external partners.
* Drive a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning within the team and across the organization.
* Apply a can do "attitude" and finds solutions for complex distributed problems.
* Take part in roadmap planning and manage execution process
* Collaborate with leadership on long\-term vision, and strategy


**Skills, competencies and qualifications**


* 8\+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* A portfolio of past projects showcasing backend and full stack development skills, preferably on a cloud based platforms (GCP, AWS or Azure).
* Proficiency and strong experience in one or more backend languages / technologies as PHP, Python, Java, and familiarity with frontend Javascript frameworks such as REACT and or Vue.JS
* In\-depth understanding of microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems. Telephony and SIP desirable.
* Experience with QA automation, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices, preferably hands\-on experience developing services in a containerization environment
* Awareness of security best practices and the ability to implement security measures to protect applications and data.
* Demonstrates critical thinking with sound analytical, debugging skills
* Strong commitment to delivering high\-quality code and solutions on time and within scope.
* Strong communicator who can express thoughts and ideas clearly and effectively.
* Demonstrated experience building strong cross functional team relationships.
* Demonstrated ability to hire and onboard developers at rapid rate.
* Experience in developing and/or assessing processes and procedures and drive meaningful improvements.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively with multiple teams across various time zones.
* Prior experience managing remote and distributed staff.
* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in relevant discipline.


**Other requirements**


* This position requires the ability to be On Call.


**Key relationships**



Manages a team of up to 15 – 25 Engineers and Managers



Key stakeholders include:


* Product Managers
* Product Architects
* Quality Assurance Team
* Cloud Platform team


Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.



View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9\.com/pt\-pt/legal.  

  



Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9\.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Java Fullstack
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.


Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**Staff Software Engineer**
===========================

**Role Overview**  

We are looking for 12\+ years of strong Full Stack Engineers with expertise in backend development using Java \& Spring Boot, and frontend development using ReactJS or React Native, with TypeScript skills. You will work across the full technology stack to design, build, and deliver high\-quality features and scalable software solutions.

 **Key Responsibilities**  

 Develop and maintain backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture  

 Build responsive, high\-quality UI using ReactJS or React Native with TypeScript  

 Collaborate with product, design, and cross\-functional engineering teams to deliver end\-to\-end features  

 Write clean, maintainable, and robust code following best practices  

 Integrate RESTful APIs and manage data flows across services  

 Contribute to architectural decisions and participate in code reviews  

 Diagnose and resolve production issues with strong ownership

**Required Skills**  

**Backend**  

 Strong knowledge of Java (8/11/17\)  

 Hands\-on experience with Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices  

 Familiarity with Hibernate/JPA  

 Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB

**Frontend**  

 Strong experience with ReactJS or React Native  

 Mandatory proficiency in TypeScript  

 Knowledge of hooks, functional components, and state management (Redux/MobX)  

 Good understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive UI

**General / Additional Skills**  

 Good understanding of Git, CI/CD, and DevOps practices  

 Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)  

 Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities

**Preferred Qualifications**  

 Experience with Docker, Kubernetes  

 Knowledge of event\-driven systems or Kafka  

 Exposure to unit testing and UI testing tools (JUnit, Jest, Cypress, etc.)  

 Experience in fintech or large\-scale distributed systems is a plus

**Education**  

 BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or any engineering stream (mandatory)

**Why Join Candescent?**  

 Opportunity to work on modern tech and high\-impact products  

 Collaborative, learning\-friendly, and transparent work culture  

 Competitive compensation and growth opportunities

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**  

To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.
